The hernial sac measured approximately 12 x 14 x 18 cm and contained the superior mesenteric vessels along its anterior wall. Several bowel segments within the sac were slightly distended; however, parietal enhancement was preserved, suggesting viable tissue without signs of ischemia (Figures 1-2).
